name: hashira-semantic-release-publish-release-true-fixture
description: Fixture for the semantic-release-publish released=true smoke test. Used by the `semantic-release-publish-released-true-smoke` self-CI job: the job inits a fresh git repo inside this directory at runtime and seeds a single `feat:` commit so semantic-release's --dry-run --no-ci path emits its 'The next release version is X.Y.Z' line. Defense in depth: `private: true` blocks any accidental real publish even if dry-run were bypassed.
